description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

John Deere is a company focused on developing technology and products that address challenges in food, fiber, and infrastructure. The Embedded Software Engineer will develop and maintain embedded software for machine control systems, deliver software features and documentation, and support testing, validation, defect resolution, and cross-functional product integration.
Embedded software engineer developing, testing, and diagnosing machine control systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain embedded software for machine control systems
• Deliver software features, diagnostics, and technical documentation
• Identify and resolve software defects through testing and validation
• Integrate software solutions with cross-functional teams to support product delivery

Requirements:
• Proficiency in C/C++ programming and fundamental software engineering principles for embedded systems
• Understanding of real-time embedded systems, microcontrollers, and hardware/software interactions
• Knowledge of vehicle communication networks and diagnostics, including CAN/J1939 protocols
• Ability to debug, test, and resolve software defects using structured problem-solving and software validation practices
• Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with systems, product design, validation, and vehicle engineering teams
• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally, up to 10%
• Ideally you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following:
• • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering
• VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position

Preferred:
• Hands-on experience developing embedded systems
• Demonstrated ability to integrate software with hardware, sensors, controllers, or communication networks
• CAN, USB, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth communications experience
• Experience or understanding of best practices for source control (e.g. GitHub, etc.)
• Strong curiosity and learning agility with a track record of quickly mastering new technologies, tools, and development environments
• Experience with technology solutions used in the construction industry, such as grade control and GNSS, telematics, etc
• Familiarity with operating Construction, Forestry, or Ag off-road equipment
